title: Untitled: Do not suffer your mind to…
text: Do not suffer your mind to brood over the external distinetions of society. Neither seek nor avoid those who are superior in fortune; meet them on the same ground as you do the rest of your fellow-creatures. There is a dignified medium between cringing for notice, and acting like a cat that puts up her back and spits, when she sees a dog at a distance, though it may have no design of coming near to her.
